kind.description:
Only return suggestions of this kind.

* `certify` - Certify
* `deprecate` - Deprecate
* `materialize` - Materialize

limit.description: Number of results to return per page.

offset.description: The initial index from which to return the results.

status.description:
Only return suggestions in this status.

* `proposed` - Proposed
* `accepted` - Accepted
* `dismissed` - Dismissed
* `expired` - Expired
* `auto_resolved` - Auto-resolved
